scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “The Artinian Lex-Plus-Powers Betti Theorem” (preprints/The-Artinian-Lex-Plus-Powers-Betti-Theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 200 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 81874e1994ff2773), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let S = C[x1, . . . , xn], let 2 ≤ a1 ≤ · · · ≤ an, and put P = (xa1 1 , . . . , xan n ). For every monomial ideal K ⊇ P, there is a monomial ideal H ⊇ P stable in the box such that dimC(S/H)d = dimC(S/K)d (d ∈ Z) and βS p,j(S/K) ≤ βS p,j(S/H) (p ≥ 0, j ∈ Z).
